radiusSource: Radius 1.28018 solar radii from Hord et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-261.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract): 890,621 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
